presets.name: Today: 52 supervisory unions and districts
presets.desc: Each of Vermont's 52 supervisory unions and supervisory districts, with its member towns as listed by VCGI. These are the units the Act 73 and Act 170 debates set out to combine.

presets.name: Act 170 merger committee groupings (2026)
presets.desc: The 20 school-district groupings that Act 170 of 2026, Sec. 14, gives facilitators as guidance for merger committees. Three Paine Mountain, Wells Spring and Stratton towns sit in a different group from the rest of their SU. Rivendell and SAU 70 are interstate and not grouped.

presets.name: House Education draft map (February 2026)
presets.desc: Rep. Conlon's first draft (presented February 5, 2026): 27 supervisory districts of about 2,000 to 4,000 students, plus the two interstate districts. Drawn from the school-district list in the Joint Fiscal Office's March 11 analysis; Poultney (Quarry Valley) and Roxbury (Montpelier Roxbury) are placed where that list is ambiguous. Numbers follow the draft, which skips 10 and 23.

presets.name: Senate Education map, version 6 (March 2026)
presets.desc: Sen. Bongartz's version 6 (March 23, 2026): 12 new supervisory unions from its district-builder link, with the "grey area" (most of Chittenden, Addison, Franklin and central Washington County) keeping today's units. These are supervisory units, which can contain several school districts.

presets.name: Act 170 Cooperative Educational Service Areas
presets.desc: The seven CESAs created in statute by Act 170 of 2026, Sec. 2. They share services; they are not school districts.

presets.name: Governor's proposal (January 2025)
presets.desc: The five regions in the Governor's January 2025 education transformation proposal, as coded by VCGI.

presets.name: School Board Association regions
presets.desc: The Vermont School Boards Association regions, one of the scenarios the Agency of Education mapped for the Redistricting Task Force.

presets.name: Career and technical center regions
presets.desc: Towns grouped by the career and technical center that serves them. A 13-district CTE-based map was the one proposal the Task Force voted on in November 2025.
